transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?
I’m just so worn out. Walking from the bedroom to the kitchen feels like I’ve been hauling lumber all day, and resting doesn’t seem to give me anything back.
Alongside this profound tiredness, how has your mood been lately?
My mood’s been very low. I wake up with this heavy, hopeless feeling in my chest, and some days I just sit out in the garage and cry. I don’t always even know what set it off.
About how long have you been feeling this low and exhausted?
About four months now. It started around when my wife went back to working full-time, and I was alone most weekdays.
Have you ever experienced a period like this in your life before, where you felt this low or exhausted?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of another time it’s been like this.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you normally enjoy doing?
Yeah. I used to look forward to choir, pickup ball, working on cars, grilling for the family... now I just can’t make myself care enough to go, or even answer people when they text me.
How has your sleep been over these past few months?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really paid much attention to my sleep.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over these past few months?
I don’t know, honestly. I haven’t really noticed any changes with that.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating or keeping your focus lately?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid close attention to whether my focus has changed.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn't worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
Yeah… I keep thinking I should just be dead. And when I’m alone, it scares me, because I start thinking I might actually do something to make that happen.
